authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Official Planning Data Local plan boundary dataset contains 364 boundary records, is MHCLG-created, OGL v3.0 licensed, and its specification requires polygon/multipolygon geometry. This is a previously unused official source window and provides suitable coverage-area geometry in principle. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition still has no authoritative LPA/local-plan-boundary reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate, LAD/GSS code, or equivalent binding identifier, so choosing any boundary would be guessing. No source-area or parcel record accepted.
